problem_spec:
def problem_spec
-- function signature
(implementation: List Int → Bool)
-- inputs
(numbers: List Int) :=
let non_ordered := ∃ i j,
i < numbers.length - 1 ∧
j < numbers.length - 1 ∧
(numbers[i]! < numbers[i+1]!) ∧
(numbers[j+1]! < numbers[j]!);
-- spec
let spec (result: Bool) :=
  (1 < numbers.length) →
  (result ↔ ¬non_ordered);
-- program termination
∃ result, implementation numbers = result ∧
spec result
